variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: An evaluation platform is the system of record and execution layer for measuring an AI application's behavior. It stores versioned test cases, runs a specific application configuration, captures outputs and traces, applies automated and human judgments, and turns the resulting evidence into an engineering decision.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Treat evaluation as an evidence lifecycle”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Version the claim and cases
pairs.detail: Record the behavior, risk slice, dataset snapshot, rubric, owner, and release threshold before seeing candidate results.
pairs.explanation: Record the behavior, risk slice, dataset snapshot, rubric, owner, and release threshold before seeing candidate results.

pairs.label: Execute a frozen configuration
pairs.detail: Replay the application, retrieval, tools, prompts, models, and environment with bounded concurrency and captured failures.
pairs.explanation: Replay the application, retrieval, tools, prompts, models, and environment with bounded concurrency and captured failures.

pairs.label: Combine independent judgments
pairs.detail: Attach deterministic checks, calibrated model judges, human annotations, disagreement, and adjudication to each case.
pairs.explanation: Attach deterministic checks, calibrated model judges, human annotations, disagreement, and adjudication to each case.

pairs.label: Decide and learn
pairs.detail: Apply hard gates, preserve the decision record, monitor a bounded rollout, and promote validated incidents into future datasets.
pairs.explanation: Apply hard gates, preserve the decision record, monitor a bounded rollout, and promote validated incidents into future datasets.

variants.hint: Give each part the one job only it can do, then rule out the rest. If benchmark and scoring concepts are new, begin with comprehensive evaluation benchmarks before selecting platform infrastructure.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Version the claim and cases: Record the behavior, risk slice, dataset snapshot, rubric, owner, and release threshold before seeing candidate results. Execute a frozen configuration: Replay the application, retrieval, tools, prompts, models, and environment with bounded concurrency and captured failures. Combine independent judgments: Attach deterministic checks, calibrated model judges, human annotations, disagreement, and adjudication to each case. Decide and learn: Apply hard gates, preserve the decision record, monitor a bounded rollout, and promote validated incidents into future datasets.

variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: An evaluation platform is the system of record and execution layer for measuring an AI application's behavior. It stores versioned test cases, runs a specific application configuration, captures outputs and traces, applies automated and human judgments, and turns the resulting evidence into an engineering decision.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Choose an operating model before a product”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Framework-integrated managed service
pairs.detail: Useful when application traces, datasets, evaluators, and developer workflows already live in one framework ecosystem.
pairs.explanation: Useful when application traces, datasets, evaluators, and developer workflows already live in one framework ecosystem. LangSmith is one current example. Test export, identity, retention, and behavior outside the preferred framework.

pairs.label: Evaluation-first managed service
pairs.detail: Useful when immutable experiments, side-by-side analysis, scorers, and CI execution are the primary workflow.
pairs.explanation: Useful when immutable experiments, side-by-side analysis, scorers, and CI execution are the primary workflow. Braintrust is one current example. Test governance, regional controls, and cost at production volume.

pairs.label: Open or self-hostable platform
pairs.detail: Useful when data locality, custom deployment, or direct storage control dominates.
pairs.explanation: Useful when data locality, custom deployment, or direct storage control dominates. Langfuse and Arize Phoenix provide current paths in this category. Include upgrades, backups, queues, observability, and incident ownership in total cost.

pairs.label: Existing experiment ecosystem
pairs.detail: Useful when model experiments, traces, artifacts, and team access already use the same platform.
pairs.explanation: Useful when model experiments, traces, artifacts, and team access already use the same platform. W&B Weave is one current example. Verify that LLM-specific review and release workflows meet the product's needs.

pairs.label: Composable internal platform
pairs.detail: Useful when regulation, scale, or unique workflows justify owning the contracts.
pairs.explanation: Useful when regulation, scale, or unique workflows justify owning the contracts. Buy or reuse commodity tracing, storage, and annotation pieces; do not rebuild a dashboard before the evidence model is stable.

pairs.label: Hybrid control plane
pairs.detail: Keep canonical datasets, manifests, and release policy in owned storage while using managed runners or review tools.
pairs.explanation: Keep canonical datasets, manifests, and release policy in owned storage while using managed runners or review tools. This reduces migration risk but adds integration and identity boundaries that need testing.

variants.hint: Give each part the one job only it can do, then rule out the rest. If benchmark and scoring concepts are new, begin with comprehensive evaluation benchmarks before selecting platform infrastructure.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Evaluation-first managed service: Useful when immutable experiments, side-by-side analysis, scorers, and CI execution are the primary workflow. Open or self-hostable platform: Useful when data locality, custom deployment, or direct storage control dominates. Existing experiment ecosystem: Useful when model experiments, traces, artifacts, and team access already use the same platform. Composable internal platform: Useful when regulation, scale, or unique workflows justify owning the contracts. Hybrid control plane: Keep canonical datasets, manifests, and release policy in owned storage while using managed runners or review tools.

pairs.label: Define the evidence schema

pairs.label: Pilot one release path

pairs.explanation: Integrate one service end to end, calibrate reviewers, and verify that a failed gate blocks deployment with a useful reason.

pairs.label: Automate by cadence
pairs.detail: Run fast deterministic checks on changes, broader suites before release, and sampled production scoring after deployment.
pairs.explanation: Run fast deterministic checks on changes, broader suites before release, and sampled production scoring after deployment.

pairs.label: Test recovery and exit
pairs.detail: Restore from backup, replay an interrupted experiment, export complete evidence, and rehearse migration before lock-in is expensive.
pairs.explanation: Restore from backup, replay an interrupted experiment, export complete evidence, and rehearse migration before lock-in is expensive.

variants.title: Make the decision

It stores versioned test cases, runs a specific application configuration, captures outputs and traces, applies automated and human judgments, and turns the resulting evidence into an engineering decision.
variants.prompt: What is the core invariant of an evaluation platform?
options: Every experiment must use the same model provider.
Every result must remain traceable to the exact evidence and configuration that produced it.
The dashboard must show one aggregate score.
Human review must replace automated scoring.
variants.explanation: A platform is trustworthy only when a result can be reproduced from a versioned dataset, application configuration, outputs, evaluator definitions, and review decisions.

Hold because the critical slice violates a hard release condition.
Delete the safety slice from the dataset.
Average the safety result with latency.

variants.prompt: Why should the evaluator version be stored with each experiment?

It lets teams distinguish application changes from scoring-rule or judge changes.
It removes the need to version datasets.
It makes reviewer disagreement impossible.

variants.prompt: Which selection approach is most durable when choosing an evaluation platform?

Match the evidence contract, operating model, portability, scale, and reviewer workflow to team constraints, then verify current product capabilities.
Choose only by dashboard appearance.
Assume self-hosting has no operational cost.
